create_subclass_generate_data: create a subclass of BaseModel that implements generate_data to forward sample from a prior distribution
create_subclass_evaluate_posterior_predi: create a subclass of BaseModel that implements evaluate_posterior_predictive to compute predictive log likelihood
implement_additional_metrics: implement the additional_metrics method in a BaseModel subclass to compute custom model-specific metrics
review_Basemodel_abstract_interface: review the BaseModel abstract class and its generate_data and evaluate_posterior_predictive interface methods
build_model_subclass: build a python module that subclasses BaseModel and implements generate_data and evaluate_posterior_predictive for a new model
